title: AI advisory product critique lane
goal: Use T590 local AI for bounded product critique without granting mutation, policy, acceptance, or release authority.
laws: AI critique is ADVISORY only and authorityGranted is always false.
Proposal binds exact candidate commit and artifact digest.
Producer node/model and proposal digest are durable evidence.
Only operator or gpt-control may select a proposal for Factory Refine.
Selection creates feedback only; Hephaestus/Talos remain required for mutation.
